t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. Top left: a small mono eyebrow, a large light-weight sans headline and a two-line mono lede. Left: three thin-outlined boxed rows, each with a mono numeral and steel-blue slash in its own cell and a short mono note for <CONTENT>. Right: a slightly darker greige panel filled by one oversized ultra-light white numeral, a mono uppercase unit, a fine tick scale and a single limit tick with a small outlined tag. A steel-blue rule under the panel. Square corners, flat, calm.
signature_idea: A whole PQ programme summed up as one instrument reading: a giant light sample count on a tick scale with a single limit tag.
strengths: readout panel is a clear, ownable visual idea for a key figure
palette stays strictly limestone, navy and one steel-blue accent
light headline and mono figures match the type system
phase rows are short and scannable
weaknesses: white numeral on greige is low contrast
tick scale and limit tag mean nothing for a sample count; there is no limit to a count
all-mono body with bold highlights is heavy and dense
invented figures (12 points, 28 days, 336) would read as real
stray short steel-blue dash in the panel is unexplained
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy and one steel-blue accent with a light headline, mono figures and square corners fit closely, but the limit scale is decorative and the numeral contrast is weak.
